## Change and acceptance

Explain the problem, resulting behavior, and linked specification/acceptance IDs.

## Evidence

Record commands actually run, the tested revision, and results. Identify blocked
or unexecuted checks explicitly. Link useful test or CI reports.

## Review considerations

Describe relevant compatibility, resource ownership, privacy, deployment and
rollback risks. Explain intentional changes to checks, fixtures or agent guidance.

## Human ownership

Name the engineer responsible for the result. Describe one independently reviewed
edge case and the tradeoff they can explain without relying on agent output.
